title: Developer-LLM Conversations: An Empirical Study of Interactions and Generated Code Quality
abstract: arXiv:2509.10402v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used by developers for conversational coding assistance, including code generation, technical questions, and iterative problem solving. However, limited empirical evidence exists on the topics developers discuss with LLMs, how interaction patterns vary across tasks, and how the quality of generated code changes across conversational turns. To address this, we construct CodeChat, a large-scale dataset derived from WildChat. CodeChat contains 587,568 real-world developer-LLM conversations and 1.7 million code snippets across more than 20 programming languages. We identify the topics developers raise and examine how their engagement varies across topics. We then assess the quality of generated code across five programming languages (i.e., Python, JavaScript, C++, Java, and C#) and analyze how quality issues evolve across conversational turns. We find that developers most frequently seek help

translated_title: 开发者与大语言模型的对话：交互行为与生成代码质量的实证研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被开发者用于对话式编程辅助，包括代码生成、技术问题解答和迭代式问题求解。然而，关于开发者与LLM讨论的主题、交互模式在不同任务间如何变化，以及生成代码的质量如何随对话轮次演变，目前仍缺乏实证证据。为解决这一问题，我们构建了CodeChat，这是一个源自WildChat的大规模数据集。CodeChat包含587,568个真实的开发者-LLM对话和170万个代码片段，涵盖20多种编程语言。我们识别了开发者提出的话题，并考察了他们在不同话题上的参与度差异。随后，我们评估了五种编程语言（即Python、JavaScript、C++、Java和C#）所生成代码的质量，并分析了质量问题如何随对话轮次演变。我们发现开发者最常寻求帮助……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了包含58万余个真实开发者-LLM对话和170万代码片段的大规模数据集CodeChat，系统揭示了开发者与LLM交互的话题分布，以及生成代码质量随对话轮次的演变规律。
en_tdlr: This study constructs CodeChat, a large-scale dataset of over 587K real-world developer-LLM conversations and 1.7M code snippets, systematically revealing the topics developers discuss with LLMs and how generated code quality evolves across conversational turns.
